d.ko: Welcome to Botany Manor, a stately home in 19th century England. You play as inhabitant Arabella Greene, a retired botanist. Explore your house and gardens, filled with research, to figure out the ideal habitat of forgotten flora. Grow each plant to discover the mysterious qualities they hold…

d.zh: 欢迎来到19世纪的英格兰，来到占地广阔的植物学庄园。你将化身庄园退休的植物学家阿拉贝拉·葛林，探索楼房内外，研究被人遗忘的植物，帮助它们找到理想的生长环境。悉心照料每一株植物，发现它们神秘的特质……
